title: エンディング（ノーマル）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess has managed to leave quite a mark on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we've successfully navigated the crucial first three years of her career.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! What training should we start off with today?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, energy means power! And power means strength!
choice_data_list: Those kind of sound like the same thing…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Mmm… Well, the main point is that strength is vital!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm going to need a lot more strength if I hope to become my ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want to continue to be someone I'm proud of. It's too soon to stop now.
choice_data_list: That's what it means to be a princess.
That's what it means to be a princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yes! Now then, I'll warm up with a light run around the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess starts running around the track. She called it a warm-up, but she shoots past like a gale.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: "You can become stronger than a raging tempest."
"You can become stronger than a raging tempest."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, right, the next line is…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "My prince, how did my running and my spirit appear in your eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wait, I think that's enough reciting of Princess Fighter lines.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Tell me for real, Trainer. How do I look in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want to hear it in your own words.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And in my eyes, you're the ultimate trainer!
